artifactSnapshot.note: This snapshot is a recovery checkpoint from directory inventory. Future progress must be recomputed by validate_situation_audit.py rather than incrementing this block manually.

parallelReleaseQuarantine.policy: Keep the official answer and authored content, but do not release the affected question until its specialist concern is resolved. Do not stop unrelated scenario authoring or canonicalization.

completionModel.contentAuthoringPass: all 60 scenarios have exactly the expected 3 question IDs and all 3 have point/detail/explanationEvidenceRefs/evidenceCheckedDate with no conflicting duplicate content
completionModel.canonicalPass: contentAuthoringPass + integrated canonical JSON regenerated + final canonical validator PASS
completionModel.releasePass: canonicalPass + affected media/scoring/content/expert quarantines resolved or explicitly excluded from release

knownHistoricalFailureModes: next scenario stem leaking into previous question choices during PDF extraction
family member wording such as 男児 being misread as the patient identity during classification
